items.answer: The warehouse lease runs for ten (10) years. This is stated in the "2. Term" clause of the "Unit 7 Lease" document, which specifies that "The term is ten (10) years starting on 1 April 2025 and ending on 31 March 2035 (the 'Term')" [3].

evidence.quote: The term is ten (10) years starting on 1 April 2025 and ending on 31 March 2035 (the "Term")

items.question: At which facility does Kestrel store Voss-Lindqvist's equipment?
items.answer: The documents state that Kestrel stores Voss-Lindqvist's equipment at the Brookfield facility. This is specified in the Storage Services Agreement between the parties [1].
